就在冷欣的匕首即将刺向陆明胸口的瞬间，一道身影突然一闪，挡在了陆明面前，正是余元山。

他神色严肃，语气凝重地说道：

“冷欣，住手！”

冷欣的匕首停在半空中，眼中闪过一丝不解与愤怒，看向余元山，语气冰冷地说道：

“局长，这是我和他之间的私事，与749局的任务无关，你为什么要拦我？”

余元山摇了摇头，沉声道：“私事？现在我们身处桃源古镇，深陷险境，陆明知道很多秘密，他不能死！杀了他，我们就失去了一条重要的线索，想要查明杨瑞的阴谋，就会更加困难！”

冷欣情绪激动，嘶吼道：“我不管！他背叛我，偷我的蛊鼎，我必须杀了他！线索没了可以再找，可我的仇，必须报！”

陆明见状，连忙抓住机会，再次对着余元山磕头求饶。

“局长，求你救我，求你救我！我知道很多秘密，我知道杨瑞的阴谋，我知道上古邪物的事情，我还知道冷欣的蛊鼎用来做什么，求你饶了我，我全都告诉你们！”

众人闻言心中不由的一动，冷欣的动作也是一顿。

陆明又转头看向被蛊虫控制的杨瑞，声音带着一丝急切与哀求。

“杨镇长，求你救我！你不能落井下石啊！当初是你指示我去勾引冷欣，去偷她的蛊鼎，说那是你需要的东西，现在东西已经给你了，你不能不管我啊！你忘了吗？那个东西，在启动仪式上，还需要我来完成最后一步，我要是死了，你的计划就泡汤了！”

这句话如同惊雷一般，在西厢房内炸开。被蛊虫控制的杨瑞，浑身猛地一震，空洞的眼神瞬间有了一丝清明，脸上露出痛苦的神色，喉咙里发出一阵压抑的闷哼。

杨瑞浑身颤抖。那枚控制他心智的蛊虫，在他体内剧烈躁动起来，仿佛要冲破他的经脉。

陆明见杨瑞有了反应，连忙继续哀求道：

“杨镇长，我说的都是真的！是你让我去接近冷欣，偷她的蛊鼎，说那是炼身炉的重要零件，没有它，你就无法复活你的爱人乔乐！求你救我，我还能帮你完成仪式，求你别不管我！”

“乔乐……炼身炉……”

杨瑞喃喃自语，眼中的痛苦愈发浓烈，体内的真炁开始剧烈翻腾，他猛地闭上双眼，浑身剧烈颤抖起来，嘴角渗出一丝鲜血。显然陆明的话触动了他心中最深处的执念，也让他有了反抗蛊虫控制的力量。

“啊——！”

杨瑞发出一声痛苦的嘶吼，猛地睁开双眼，眼中再无半分茫然，取而代之的是冰冷的杀意与决绝。他猛地抬手，按在自己的脖颈处，体内的真炁疯狂涌动，硬生生将那枚蛊虫从皮肤中逼了出来，蛊虫落地的瞬间，便被他的真炁碾压成了粉末。

破解蛊术的瞬间，杨瑞喷出一大口鲜血，脸色瞬间变得苍白如纸，显然强行破蛊，让他身受重伤。但他丝毫没有在意自己的伤势，眼神冰冷地看向冷欣，身形一闪，便朝着冷欣冲了过去，抬手一掌，狠狠拍在冷欣的胸口。

“噗——！”

Just when Leng Xin's dagger was about to stab Lu Ming's chest, a figure suddenly flashed and stood in front of Lu Ming. It was Yu Yuanshan.

He looked serious and said in a solemn tone:

"Leng Xin, stop!"

Leng Xin's dagger stopped in mid-air, a trace of confusion and anger flashed in his eyes. He looked at Yu Yuanshan and said in a cold tone:

"Director, this is a private matter between him and me and has nothing to do with the mission of Bureau 749. Why did you stop me?"

Yu Yuanshan shook his head and said in a deep voice: "Private matters? Now we are in the ancient town of Taoyuan and are in deep danger. Lu Ming knows many secrets. He cannot die! If we kill him, we will lose an important clue. It will be more difficult to find out Yang Rui's conspiracy!"

Leng Xin was emotional and shouted: "I don't care! He betrayed me and stole my Gu Cauldron. I must kill him! If there are no clues, we can look for them again, but my revenge must be avenged!"

Seeing this, Lu Ming quickly seized the opportunity and kowtowed to Yu Yuanshan again to beg for mercy.

"Director, please save me, please save me! I know many secrets, I know Yang Rui's conspiracy, I know about ancient evil objects, and I also know what Leng Xin's Gu Cauldron is used for. Please spare me, I will tell you all!"

Everyone's hearts couldn't help but move when they heard this, and Leng Xin's movements also stopped.

Lu Ming turned to look at Yang Rui, who was controlled by the Gu insect, with a hint of urgency and pleading in his voice.

"Mayor Yang, please save me! You can't add insult to injury! It was you who instructed me to seduce Leng Xin and steal her Gu Cauldron, saying that it was what you needed. Now that the thing has been given to you, you can't ignore me! Have you forgotten? That thing needs me to complete the last step in the launching ceremony. If I die, your plan will be ruined!"

These words were like thunder, exploding in the west wing.Yang Rui, who was controlled by the Gu insect, was shaken all over. His empty eyes suddenly became clear, a look of pain appeared on his face, and a suppressed groan came from his throat.

Yang Rui trembled all over.The Gu worm that controlled his mind began to stir violently in his body, as if it was about to break through his meridians.

Seeing Yang Rui's reaction, Lu Ming quickly continued to plead:

"Mayor Yang, everything I said is true! It was you who asked me to approach Leng Xin and steal her Gu Cauldron, saying that it was an important part of the body-training furnace. Without it, you would not be able to resurrect your lover Qiao Le! Please save me, and I can help you complete the ritual. Please don't ignore me!"

"Qiao Le...the body training furnace..."

Yang Rui murmured to himself, the pain in his eyes became more and more intense, and the energy in his body began to surge violently. He closed his eyes suddenly, his whole body trembled violently, and a trace of blood oozed from the corner of his mouth.Obviously Lu Ming's words touched the deepest obsession in his heart and gave him the power to resist the control of the Gu insect.

"Ah——!"

Yang Rui let out a painful roar and opened his eyes suddenly. There was no longer any confusion in his eyes, replaced by cold murderous intent and determination.He suddenly raised his hand and pressed it on his neck. The true energy in his body surged wildly, forcing the Gu worm out of his skin. The moment the Gu worm landed on the ground, it was crushed into powder by his true energy.

The moment he broke the bewitching spell, Yang Rui spurted out a large mouthful of blood, and his face instantly turned as pale as paper. It was obvious that the bewitching spell was broken by force and he was seriously injured.But he didn't care about his injuries at all. He looked at Leng Xin with cold eyes, and in a flash, he rushed towards Leng Xin, raised his hand and slapped Leng Xin hard on the chest.

"Pfft——!"
